description.value: The study investigated cardiac autonomic reactivity to dynamic facial emotions across frontotemporal dementia syndromes and its anatomical correlates in regional gray matter volume.

value: We hypothesized that cardiac modulation would be attenuated in bvFTD and nfvPPA due to degeneration of fronto‐insular networks in these diseases, but relatively preserved (and separable from emotion identification) in syndromes targeting the anterior temporal lobes (svPPA and rtvFTD).

We further hypothesized that emotion recognition ability but not cardiac reactivity would be associated with semantic knowledge, while cardiac reactivity would correlate with atrophy in components of the central autonomic regulatory network (ACC, insula, OFC).

description.value: Observational cross-sectional study of patients with frontotemporal dementia syndromes and healthy older controls.
